extracted.intended_audience: national patent offices, patent applicants, patent attorneys, and policymakers dealing with PCT filings
extracted.subtask_description: Requirements and procedural standards of the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) governing international patent applications, searches, preliminary examination, administrative provisions, and related national/elected office procedures. Useful for drafting, filing, prosecuting, and evaluating PCT international applications and related national phase actions.
